task: Create a JSON policy document that grants read-only access to all S3 buckets for a specific IAM user
solution_criteria: Must be valid IAM policy JSON with Version, Statement containing Effect 'Allow', Action for S3 read operations, Resource for all S3 buckets, and proper JSON syntax

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS region name and returns the corresponding S3 endpoint URL
solution_criteria: Function should accept region parameter, return properly formatted S3 endpoint URL (https://s3.region.amazonaws.com or https://s3.amazonaws.com for us-east-1), handle standard AWS regions correctly

task: Create a regex pattern that validates AWS ARN (Amazon Resource Name) format for Lambda functions
solution_criteria: Regex must match the pattern 'arn:aws:lambda:region:account-id:function:function-name', validate region format (e.g., us-east-1), 12-digit account ID, and function name containing alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores
